notice: Public-transport lines and map connections are schematic planning references, not turn-by-turn navigation. Check each operator's live journey planner on the day of travel.

segments.label: Star Ferry · Central–Tsim Sha Tsui
segments.description: A cross-harbour connection between the Central and Tsim Sha Tsui film-location clusters.

historical-timeline.label: Star Ferry · the route's only harbour crossing
historical-timeline.description: After the three Tsim Sha Tsui stops, walk west to the Star Ferry and cross once to Central Pier 7. Continue on foot through the remaining Central locations.

cinematic-food-trail.label: Star Ferry · Central to Tsim Sha Tsui
cinematic-food-trail.description: After Pottinger Street, walk downhill to Central Pier 7 and cross to Tsim Sha Tsui. Continue on foot from the pier to Chungking Mansions, the food trail's next named location.

segments.label: KMB · 1 / 1A Nathan Road corridor
segments.description: A schematic surface-transit reference linking the Tsim Sha Tsui, Jordan, Yau Ma Tei, Mong Kok, and Prince Edward clusters.

historical-timeline.label: KMB · 1 / 1A southbound Kowloon connector
historical-timeline.to: Yau Ma Tei / Jordan / Tsim Sha Tsui
historical-timeline.description: Use this southbound corridor as an optional shortcut between the route's connected Kowloon clusters. The numbered film stops continue from north to south.

cinematic-food-trail.label: KMB · 1 / 1A food-trail corridor
cinematic-food-trail.to: Temple Street / Yau Ma Tei / Prince Edward
cinematic-food-trail.description: After the Tsim Sha Tsui and Jordan locations, this northbound corridor supports the journey towards Temple Street, Mido Cafe, the Fruit Market, and Hung Wan Cafe.

segments.label: MTR · Tsuen Wan Line alternative
segments.description: A north–south rail reference and an alternative cross-harbour connection between the principal location clusters.

historical-timeline.label: MTR · optional southbound shortcut
historical-timeline.to: Yau Ma Tei / Jordan / Tsim Sha Tsui
historical-timeline.description: Use the Tsuen Wan Line only to shorten the southbound Kowloon leg if needed. The planned harbour crossing remains the Star Ferry from Tsim Sha Tsui to Central.

cinematic-food-trail.label: MTR · cross-harbour alternative
cinematic-food-trail.description: If the ferry is unavailable, the Tsuen Wan Line provides an alternative between Central and Tsim Sha Tsui, then continues towards the trail's Yau Ma Tei and Prince Edward food locations.
